# Bid the panels, the glass, and the opening.

> Price a sliding glass or patio-door replacement from extra panels, impact glass, new-construction wrap, transom, sill pan, and balcony access — not a published $1,800-installed 6-foot vinyl special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
